name: @pipeworx/mcp-tenor

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Tenor's GIF and sticker library by keyword (q); supports locale, content-safety filter, aspect-ratio range, randomization, and pagination; returns media URLs and metadata.

tools.name: featured
tools.description: Fetch Tenor's current editorially featured GIFs; supports locale, content filter, aspect-ratio range, and pagination; returns media URLs and metadata.

tools.name: categories
tools.description: Return Tenor's GIF browse categories (e.g. trending, featured) with representative GIF previews; filterable by locale, type, and content safety level.

tools.name: search_suggestions
tools.description: Return Tenor search query suggestions related to a partial query string (q); useful for building GIF search autocomplete UIs.

tools.name: autocomplete
tools.description: Return Tenor autocomplete completions for a partial search term (q); returns up to limit completed search phrases ordered by popularity.

tools.name: trending_terms
tools.description: Trending Tenor GIF and sticker keywords — the reaction, meme, emotion and pop-culture phrases people are currently typing into Tenor to find GIFs to send in chats and messaging apps. Returns Tenor's current trending GIF keyword list for a locale.

tools.name: posts
tools.description: Fetch specific Tenor GIFs/stickers by their post IDs (ids, comma-separated) — use to re-resolve media URLs and metadata for results returned earlier by search or featured.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-tenor forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the tenor pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
